_comment: Mutation testing for the API. Runs the FAST unit vitest suite (vitest.config.js) — NOT the Postgres contract suite — so a mutant only re-runs the handful of unit tests that cover it (coverageAnalysis: perTest). Scope grows via the `mutate` list: only pure/DB-free modules whose logic is covered by src/**/*.test.js belong here; route/SQL modules are exercised by the contract suite and are out of scope. See MUTATION-TESTING.md.
